label: Along every populated descent, adjacent Grim Reaper pieces are co-possible
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred (Grim Reaper style, the analogue of a possible Placer trio placed in the slots of a past): for the supplied station-register frame, in every history v accessible from the selected world, along every strictly descending sequence of moments c whose first moment has a contingent concrete individual present in v, for every n some world accessible from v realizes both the local piece of station n and that of station n + 1. A local piece is a station at c n obeying positive trigger, emission, forwarding and admissibility relative to the station at c (n + 1). It ranges over every descent, including t, t/2, t/4, ... in dense time. It says nothing about gluing the pieces together. 'Concrete' is the supplied Concrete parameter, read under the adopted esse criterion; the Lean type does not enforce that reading.
